import numpy as np


def bistatic_doppler(p, v, tx, rx, lam):
    """Doppler shift (Hz) of the echo off an aircraft at p (m) moving at v (m/s), transmitter tx, receiver rx."""
    p, v, tx, rx = (np.asarray(a, float) for a in (p, v, tx, rx))
    u_rx = (p - rx) / np.linalg.norm(p - rx)      # unit vector receiver -> aircraft
    u_tx = (p - tx) / np.linalg.norm(p - tx)      # unit vector transmitter -> aircraft
    return -(np.dot(v, u_rx) - np.dot(v, u_tx)) / lam

import numpy as np
import pytest

from subject_under_test import bistatic_doppler


def test_bistatic_doppler_simple_positive_along_x():
    p = [1, 0, 0]
    v = [1, 0, 0]
    tx = [0, 0, 0]
    rx = [2, 0, 0]
    lam = 0.5
    assert bistatic_doppler(p, v, tx, rx, lam) == pytest.approx(4.0)


def test_bistatic_doppler_simple_negative_along_x():
    p = [1, 0, 0]
    v = [-1, 0, 0]
    tx = [0, 0, 0]
    rx = [2, 0, 0]
    lam = 0.5
    assert bistatic_doppler(p, v, tx, rx, lam) == pytest.approx(-4.0)


def test_bistatic_doppler_zero_for_perpendicular_velocity():
    p = [1, 0, 0]
    v = [0, 3, 0]
    tx = [0, 0, 0]
    rx = [2, 0, 0]
    lam = 0.5
    assert bistatic_doppler(p, v, tx, rx, lam) == pytest.approx(0.0)


def test_bistatic_doppler_off_axis_geometry():
    p = [1, 1, 0]
    v = [0, 2, 0]
    tx = [0, 0, 0]
    rx = [0, 2, 0]
    lam = 2.0
    assert bistatic_doppler(p, v, tx, rx, lam) == pytest.approx(np.sqrt(2.0))


def test_bistatic_doppler_accepts_list_inputs_and_nonunit_lambda():
    p = [3, 4, 0]
    v = [3, 4, 0]
    tx = [0, 4, 0]
    rx = [0, 0, 0]
    lam = 2.0
    assert bistatic_doppler(p, v, tx, rx, lam) == pytest.approx(-1.0)


def test_bistatic_doppler_three_dimensional_case():
    p = [2, 0, 2]
    v = [1, 2, 2]
    tx = [0, 0, 0]
    rx = [4, 0, 0]
    lam = 1.0
    # u_rx = (-1/sqrt(2), 0, 1/sqrt(2)), u_tx = (1/sqrt(2), 0, 1/sqrt(2))
    # dot(v, u_rx) = 1/sqrt(2), dot(v, u_tx) = 3/sqrt(2)
    # result = -((1/sqrt(2)) - (3/sqrt(2))) = sqrt(2)
    assert bistatic_doppler(p, v, tx, rx, lam) == pytest.approx(np.sqrt(2.0))
